ex.en: He was unable to hold himself back and wanted to go home right away.

ex.hz: 这是迄今为止我能给你的最有效的建议。
ex.py: zhè shì qìjīn-wéizhǐ wǒ néng gěi nǐ de zuì yǒuxiào de jiànyì.
ex.en: This is the most effective advice I can give you so far.

words.en: as always; as in the past

ex.hz: 我们将一如既往坚决支持你们的正义斗争。
ex.py: wǒmen jiāng yìrú-jìwǎng jiānjué zhīchí nǐmen de zhèngyì dòuzhēng.
ex.en: We will, as always, resolutely support your just struggle.

words.en: go all out; spare no effort

ex.hz: 即使她受伤了，她仍然全力以赴。
ex.py: jíshǐ tā shòushāng le, tā réngrán quánlì-yǐfù.
ex.en: Even though she was injured, she still went all out.

ex.hz: 众所周知，他第一次尝试经营公司时十分艰难。
ex.py: zhòngsuǒzhōuzhī, tā dì-yī cì chángshì jīngyíng gōngsī shí shífēn jiānnán.
ex.en: It is well-known that his first attempt at running a company was very difficult.

words.en: behoove; of course; take for granted

ex.hz: 不要认为他帮助你是理所当然的事。
ex.py: búyào rènwéi tā bāngzhù nǐ shì lǐsuǒdāngrán de shì.
ex.en: Don't take it for granted that he will help you.

words.en: try various devices to; do everything possible to

ex.hz: 我想方设法，最后终于把她说服了。
ex.py: wǒ xiǎngfāng-shèfǎ, zuìhòu zhōngyú bǎ tā shuōfú le.
ex.en: I tried every possible way, and in the end I finally persuaded her.

words.en: with great ease; something easily done

ex.hz: 他轻而易举地通过了考试。
ex.py: tā qīng'éryìjǔ de tōngguòle kǎoshì.
ex.en: He passed the exam with great ease.

ex.hz: 他是一位名副其实的好领袖。
ex.py: tā shì yí wèi míngfù-qíshí de hǎo lǐngxiù.
ex.en: He is a good leader who is truly worthy of the name.

ex.hz: 他在音乐上的成就微不足道。
ex.py: tā zài yīnyuè shàng de chéngjiù wēibùzúdào.
ex.en: His achievements in music are insignificant.

words.en: strain every nerve; do all in one's full strength

ex.hz: 我竭尽全力地做好工作。
ex.py: wǒ jiéjìn-quánlì de zuòhǎo gōngzuò.
ex.en: I strain every nerve to do my job well.

ex.hz: 这牛排煎得恰到好处。
ex.py: zhè niúpái jiān de qiàdào-hǎochù.
ex.en: This steak is fried just right.

ex.hz: 当务之急是尽快找到她。
ex.py: dāngwù-zhījí shì jǐnkuài zhǎodào tā.
ex.en: The most urgent matter is to find her as soon as possible.

words.en: make every attempt every possible effort

ex.hz: 他在千方百计地谋求这份工作。
ex.py: tā zài qiānfāng-bǎijì de móuqiú zhè fèn gōngzuò.
ex.en: He is making every possible effort to get this job.

ex.hz: 真正的爱情总不是一帆风顺的。
ex.py: zhēnzhèng de àiqíng zǒng bú shì yìfān-fēngshùn de.
ex.en: True love never goes smoothly.

ex.hz: 在所处位置，用所有资源，做力所能及之事。
ex.py: zài suǒ chǔ wèizhi, yòng suǒyǒu zīyuán, zuò lìsuǒnéngjí zhī shì.
ex.en: In your position, use all your resources to do what is within your power.

words.en: at a glance; be absolutely clear

ex.hz: 所有东西都一目了然。
ex.py: suǒyǒu dōngxi dōu yímù-liǎorán.
ex.en: Everything is clear at a glance.

ex.hz: 她在争论中起着举足轻重的作用。
ex.py: tā zài zhēnglùn zhōng qǐzhe jǔzú-qīngzhòng de zuòyòng.
ex.en: She plays a decisive role in the argument.

ex.hz: 我们要坚持实事求是的工作作风。
ex.py: wǒmen yào jiānchí shíshì-qiúshì de gōngzuò zuòfēng.
ex.en: We must uphold a work style of seeking truth from facts.

words.en: have no alternative; have no way out

ex.hz: 我们无可奈何，只得应允。
ex.py: wǒmen wúkě-nàihé, zhǐdé yīngyǔn.
ex.en: We had no alternative but to agree.

words.en: worse; add to the misfortunes of a man who is already unfortunate

ex.hz: 她的小孩死了，雪上加霜的是，丈夫又弃她而去。
ex.py: tā de xiǎohái sǐ le, xuěshàng-jiāshuāng de shì, zhàngfu yòu qì tā ér qù.
ex.en: Her child died, and to make things worse, her husband also abandoned her.

ex.hz: 他们等着看一眼那位家喻户晓的女明星。
ex.py: tāmen děngzhe kàn yìyǎn nà wèi jiāyù-hùxiǎo de nǚmíngxīng.
ex.en: They were waiting to catch a glimpse of that actress known to every family.

ex.hz: 不言而喻，驾车会造成拥堵、污染和事故。
ex.py: bùyán-éryù, jiàchē huì zàochéng yōngdǔ, wūrǎn hé shìgù.
ex.en: It is self-evident that driving causes congestion, pollution, and accidents.

ex.hz: 在我们工作的过程中，出乎意料的事层出不穷。
ex.py: zài wǒmen gōngzuò de guòchéng zhōng, chūhū-yìliào de shì céngchūbùqióng.
ex.en: In the course of our work, unexpected things emerge in an endless stream.

words.en: shoot two hawks with one arrow
words.enShort: shoot two hawks with one arrow

ex.hz: 这样既节约钱又节约水，一举两得。
ex.py: zhèyàng jì jiéyuē qián yòu jiéyuē shuǐ, yìjǔ-liǎngdé.
ex.en: This saves both money and water, so it is like shooting two hawks with one arrow.

ex.hz: 环境对音乐教学起着潜移默化的作用。
ex.py: huánjìng duì yīnyuè jiàoxué qǐzhe qiányí-mòhuà de zuòyòng.
ex.en: The environment has an imperceptible influence on music teaching.

ex.hz: 我们必须坚持统筹兼顾。
ex.py: wǒmen bìxū jiānchí tǒngchóu-jiāngù.
ex.en: We must insist on balanced, overall consideration.

words.en: paint a snake with feet superfluous

ex.hz: 我不认为此举是画蛇添足，相反我发现它非常重要。
ex.py: wǒ bú rènwéi cǐ jǔ shì huàshé-tiānzú, xiāngfǎn wǒ fāxiàn tā fēicháng zhòngyào.
ex.en: I don't think this move is superfluous like adding feet to a snake; on the contrary, I find it very important.

words.en: carry on the cause of one's predecessors and forge ahead into the future
words.enShort: carry on the cause of one's…

ex.hz: 我们将要在领导的关怀和指导下继往开来，再创奇迹。
ex.py: wǒmen jiāngyào zài lǐngdǎo de guānhuái hé zhǐdǎo xià jìwǎng-kāilái, zài chuàng qíjì.
ex.en: Under our leaders' care and guidance, we will carry on the cause of our predecessors and forge ahead into the future, creating miracles again.

ex.hz: 艰苦的时光终将过去，坚强的人必将苦尽甘来。
ex.py: jiānkǔ de shíguāng zhōngjiāng guòqù, jiānqiáng de rén bìjiāng kǔjìn-gānlái.
ex.en: Hard times will eventually pass, and strong people will surely see their sufferings rewarded.

words.en: spoil things by being too eager; help shoots grow by pulling them

ex.hz: 拔苗助长的教育方式不可取。
ex.py: bámiáo-zhùzhǎng de jiàoyù fāngshì bù kěqǔ.
ex.en: It is not advisable to rush a child's education by pulling the shoots to help them grow.

words.en: have experienced many changes and vicissitudes in human life

ex.hz: 他是一位饱经沧桑的革命老人。
ex.py: tā shì yí wèi bǎojīng-cāngsāng de gémìng lǎorén.
ex.en: He is an old revolutionary who has experienced many changes and vicissitudes in life.
